'''Electric Pylon''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|Once connected to the power grid, this pylon can wirelessly power all Endfield facilities within a sizable area of effect. 
Researching certain AIC Factory Plan technologies also gives this facility a 30-meter power transmission capability.|Wireless electrical connection is one of the biggest technological breakthroughs achieved by Endfield Industries. This tech was further improved with Techno-Protocol to provide the very foundation of the AIC Factory.}}
==Usage==
Once connected to the power grid, this pylon can wirelessly power all Endfield facilities within a sizable area of effect.
Researching certain AIC Factory Plan technologies also gives this facility a 30-meter power transmission capability.
==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Basic AIC Plan|Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Electricity I]]
